methodologyNotes: The roster covers 12 carpet cleaners spanning upright full-size, portable spot, and cordless categories from Bissell, Hoover, Rug Doctor, and Tineco. Data was re-verified against official manufacturer product pages (bissell.com, hoover.com, rugdoctor.com, us.tineco.com), major retail listings (Walmart, Best Buy, Amazon), and the official Tineco PR Newswire release. Prices reflect US MSRP or current published retail list price. tank_capacity_gal is the clean-water tank capacity converted to gallons (1 L = 0.264 gal; 1 gal = 128 oz). heated_cleaning is TRUE only when the machine has a built-in heater that actively heats the WASH water or produces steam. Hoover HeatForce is a heated-DRYING-AIR feature (it does NOT heat wash water) so every Hoover unit is heated_cleaning=false; Bissell HeatWave only maintains temperature so those are false; only true built-in heaters (Bissell Little Green ProHeat/HydroSteam, Tineco PTC, etc.) are true. Cord length is null for cordless units. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Corrections from the draft: Hoover FH53000 path width 14.49->12 in (14.49 was assembled-unit width); Hoover FH50710 and FH50251 heated_cleaning true->false (HeatForce is drying, not wash-water heating, contradicting the draft's own rule); Hoover FH50251 price 275.99->199.95 (Walmart published); Big Green 86T3 release 2014->null (unverifiable on any primary source); Spotless Go BH12001 source URL replaced (draft URL pointed to the unrelated corded FH11300 page).

The Consumer Reports lab review for the StainStriker PX201 corroborates it as a portable carpet cleaner and provides the machine's empty weight of 9 lbs (full 12 lbs) plus a shop price "from $99.00"; I used the 9 lb empty weight because the manufacturer spec table's 13.23 lbs is the boxed/shipping weight and contradicts the same page's "under 9 lbs" claim. The official Tineco press release (corroboration), dated November 1, 2022, states verbatim "CARPET ONE Spot is now available for purchase on Amazon.com and Tineco.com for $499," fixing both the $499 launch MSRP and the 2022 release; that same release identifies the cheaper $399 "CARPET ONE Essentials" as a distinct model, so the Amazon B0B5XN4TT5 listing (branded "Spot Essentials," 0.8 L, 10-25 min runtime, $399) was rejected as the wrong variant. tank_capacity_gal (0.4) is the verbatim 1.5 L clean tank converted using the dataset's documented 1 L = 0.264 gal rule.
